commands:
set -eu
echo RECENT_RUNTIME_ROWS
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom deployment/phantom-postgres -- psql -U phantom -d phantom -Atc "SELECT event_id,event_type,comm,executable_path,tgid,pid_start_time_ns,namespace,pod_name,container_id,image_digest,COALESCE(sbom_id::text,''),COALESCE(purl,''),COALESCE(binding_status,''),received_at::text FROM drift_events WHERE received_at >= '2026-10-26T09:48:50Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 12;"
echo CAUSAL_PROCESSING_METRICS
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom deployment/phantom-api-gateway -- python3 -c "import json,urllib.parse,urllib.request; q=urllib.parse.urlencode({'query':'phantom_redis_stream_messages_total'}); d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://prometheus.monitoring.svc.cluster.local:9090/api/v1/query?'+q,timeout=5)); [print(x['metric'],x['value'][1]) for x in d.get('data',{}).get('result',[])]"
echo CAUSAL_LOG_SUMMARY
k3s kubectl logs -n phantom deployment/phantom-causal-engine --since=10m | grep -E 'consumer|processed|dead_letter|error|starting' | tail -35 || true
echo REDIS_GROUP_PROGRESS
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom deployment/phantom-redis -- redis-cli XINFO GROUPS phantom:drift-events
